decision.reasoning_trace: Upon reviewing the product feed, a significant portion of the results consisted of camping accessories like chairs, towels, and stoves rather than actual backpacks, which made for a fragmented browsing experience. Within the consideration set of backpacks, I found concerning reviews: the hydration packs (N NEVO RHINO and Sojourner) had several reports of leaking bladders and low-quality materials. The KAILAS 28L hiking pack appeared to have the best technical specifications, but with only 8 reviews, there was insufficient social proof to justify the $69.99 price tag. Consequently, I decided not to make a purchase during this session.
